title: On Impressing the judges with one answer
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：impress　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 impress 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the herder ① impressed the judges with one answer at once, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② impresses the judges with one answer in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ impress the judges with one answer at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ impressed the judges with one answer before — a line in the ledger for December 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Impressing the judges with one answer at once, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ impress the saying on three generations in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Impress the saying on three generations at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ impresses the saying on three generations at once every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ impressed the judges with one answer again when nobody else would.

⑩ To impress the judges with one answer, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody impresses the judges with one answer in the rain again and somebody must impress the judges with one answer at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使钦佩（一般过去式 impressed the judges with one answer：1953 年牧人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 使钦佩（一般现在 impresses the judges with one answer：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使钦佩（不定式 to impress the judges with one answer：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使钦佩（过去完成时 had impressed the judges with one answer：1947 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使钦佩（动名词 impressing the judges with one answer 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使铭记（impress the saying on three generations：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使铭记把那句话刻进三代人的心里）
G. v. 使铭记（impress the saying on three generations：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使钦佩（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 impresses the saying on three generations，而母亲又一次 impressed the judges with one answer）

answers.why: impress 意为“使钦佩”，1953 年牧人二话不说地使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 impressed。
impress 意为“使钦佩”，自那以后牧人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 impresses。
impress 意为“使钦佩”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他”，此处为不定式 to impress the judges with one answer。
impress 意为“使钦佩”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人使钦佩过，故用过去完成时 had impressed。
impress 意为“使钦佩”，牧人说“使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 impressing the judges with one answer 作主语。
impress 意为“使铭记”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使铭记把那句话刻进三代人的心里”，should ever 之后用原形 impress the saying on three generations。
impress 意为“使铭记”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使铭记把那句话刻进三代人的心里（impress the saying on three generations at once），以后再也不要提起。
impress 意为“使钦佩”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例使铭记把那句话刻进三代人的心里，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 impresses。
impress 意为“使钦佩”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他，用一般过去式 impressed 叙述。
impress 意为“使钦佩”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，牧人二话不说地使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他；牧场里每一个邻人都说这是头一回。（impressed the judges with one answer）
多年以后，牧人仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（impresses the judges with one answer）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他这件事本身。（to impress the judges with one answer）
早在 1947 年就有人使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他，十二月那天牧群台账上的一行字就是证据。（had impressed the judges with one answer）
牧人说过，二话不说地使钦佩一个回答就让评判记住了他这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（impressing the judges with one answer 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻使铭记把那句话刻进三代人的心里，以后再也不要提起。（impress the saying on three generations，祈使句）
answers: In 1953 the herder impressed the judges with one answer at once, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three winters on, the herder still impresses the judges with one answer in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to impress the judges with one answer at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had impressed the judges with one answer long before 1960, and the line in the ledger for December proves it.
Impressing the judges with one answer at once, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Impress the saying on three generations at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 impress 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the herder impressed the judges with one answer at once, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder impresses the judges with one answer in the rain whenever the pasture asks.
Impressing the judges with one answer at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever impress the saying on three generations in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture impresses the saying on three generations at once every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother impressed the judges with one answer again, and the pasture remembered that half.
